chapters.label: Greeting & Introduction
chapters.summary: Agent welcomes the customer, introduces themselves, and requests the flight number.

chapters.label: Problem Statement
chapters.summary: Customer explains they need a seat change for their child's medical needs.

chapters.label: Identity Verification
chapters.summary: Agent verifies the flight number and customer's name and last name spelling.

chapters.label: Investigation & Discussion
chapters.summary: Agent discusses baggage allowances and refund policies before addressing the seat change.

chapters.label: Options & Explanation
chapters.summary: Agent explains seat availability near the laboratory and confirms the customer's preference.

chapters.label: Resolution & Next Steps
chapters.summary: Agent changes the seat, confirms the upcharge, and updates payment details.

chapters.label: Closing
chapters.summary: Agent provides the confirmation number and concludes the call.
